interface.shortDescription: Ask Claude Code for reviews and second opinions from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Ask Claude connects Codex to Claude Code through a local MCP server and ACP. It keeps multi-turn Claude sessions, surfaces context and cost signals, and supports review or discussion loops where Codex can challenge Claude's findings before reporting back.
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude to review this change.
